fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on the 1927–1928 winter tourist season and Miami amusements; reports and opinion on city government and finance surrounding the W. A. Means embezzlement case; discussion of employment-bureau wage deductions and other petty graft; coverage of convention funding disputes involving the Elks and mention of the Shriners; notes on federal prosecution in the "Red" Shannon case; police-court and vice items; sports coverage including boxing at the Coliseum; and Miami Beach Democratic Club announcements and political commentary.
